name: AI Chatbots
description: Think through ideas, ask questions, and get help with everyday tasks.
guidance: Compare context limits, file support, source citations, and access to current information.

name: AI Writing Tools
description: Turn a first thought into clearer copy, stories, and documents.
guidance: Look for editing control, tone consistency, language support, and control over the final draft.

name: AI Image Generators
description: Explore visual ideas and create images from a prompt or reference.
guidance: Check usage rights, editing controls, output resolution, and reference consistency.

name: AI Video Generators
description: Create clips, develop scenes, and simplify video production.
guidance: Compare clip duration, motion control, resolution, credits, and audio support.

name: AI Coding Assistants
description: Get support for writing, understanding, and reviewing code.
guidance: Consider editor support, repository context, code privacy, and how changes can be reviewed.

name: AI Search Engines
description: Find answers and explore the sources behind them.
guidance: Evaluate source quality, freshness, citation accuracy, and access to original material.

name: AI Productivity Tools
description: Organize notes, meetings, and the work between them.
guidance: Check workflow compatibility, permissions, and export options.

name: AI Marketing Tools
description: Plan campaigns and create content for your audience.
guidance: Compare brand controls, channel support, approvals, and access to performance data.

name: AI SEO Tools
description: Research search intent and improve content discoverability.
guidance: Check data freshness, geographic coverage, and how estimates are distinguished from evidence.

name: AI Presentation Tools
description: Turn information into presentations with a clear story.
guidance: Compare editable exports, brand templates, source attribution, and layout control.

name: AI Audio & Music Tools
description: Explore music creation, sound editing, and audio workflows.
guidance: Review licensing, stem exports, audio quality, and editing controls.

name: AI Voice Generators
description: Create spoken audio for narration and accessible content.
guidance: Compare language coverage, pronunciation controls, consent requirements, and voice usage terms.

name: AI Translation Tools
description: Translate content and communicate across languages.
guidance: Consider language pairs, terminology glossaries, formatting, and human review for sensitive material.

name: AI Research Tools
description: Explore literature, organize evidence, and investigate ideas.
guidance: Check database coverage, citation traceability, document limits, and summary accuracy.

name: AI Data Analysis Tools
description: Explore datasets and communicate what the numbers show.
guidance: Compare file limits, reproducibility, chart exports, privacy, and access to calculations.

name: AI Automation Tools
description: Connect applications and reduce repetitive work.
guidance: Review integrations, task limits, approval steps, error handling, and action logs.

name: AI Design Tools
description: Develop layouts, visual assets, and product design ideas.
guidance: Look for editable exports, design-system support, collaboration, and software compatibility.

name: AI Education Tools
description: Support learning, lesson preparation, and guided practice.
guidance: Consider age suitability, answer quality, accessibility, student privacy, and support for understanding.

name: AI Assistants
description: Explore general-purpose help across everyday tasks.
guidance: Compare supported tasks, app access, permissions, and the level of control you retain.

name: AI Coding Agents
description: Explore tools designed to carry out software development tasks.
guidance: Check review steps, execution permissions, supported environments, and testing workflows.

name: AI Website Builders
description: Explore tools for creating websites with AI assistance.
guidance: Compare editing controls, code export, hosting requirements, accessibility, and ongoing costs.

name: AI Customer Support
description: Explore AI tools for customer questions and support workflows.
guidance: Review knowledge-source controls, human handoff, integrations, and the treatment of customer data.

name: AI Meeting Assistants
description: Explore tools for recording, transcribing, and summarizing meetings.
guidance: Compare meeting-platform support, consent controls, transcript languages, and data retention.

name: AI Agents
description: Explore tools that coordinate and perform tasks across workflows.
guidance: Check action permissions, approval steps, audit trails, and recovery when a task fails.
